address: 325 S Touchmark Way, Meridian (Touchmark / Meadow Lake Village)
owner_name: Touchmark (Touchmark at Meadow Lake Village ownership entity, affiliate of Touchmark Living Centers, Inc.)
ownership_since: Land held 20+ years; Meadow Lake Village master plan established ~2001-2003, first homes opened 2003. Original plan up to 874 retirement homes + ~20 ac medical office + commercial. Price not disclosed.
who_they_are: Touchmark is a Pacific-NW (Beaverton/Vancouver WA) developer-operator of upscale full-service senior communities, founded by Werner G. Nistler Jr. Its Idaho community, Touchmark at Meadow Lake Village (near Eagle/Franklin/Overland), sits on ~100+ acres; SM-9 is undeveloped remainder within/adjacent to that ~121-ac master plan.
intent_summary: Undeveloped portion of Touchmark's ~121-ac senior community. July 2025 Touchmark moved to overhaul the 20-yr master plan — development-modification agreement + rezone + PUD to a broader 'Touchmark Mixed Use' (mixed housing, commercial/office, clubhouse, pool). SM-9 straddles jurisdictions (Boise R-2 / Meridian L-O); part carries Industrial + MU-Community FLU rather than pure residential.
project_status: proposed (master-plan modification / rezone / PUD in progress 2025; balance already built)

address: E Amity Rd, Meridian (N side, between Meridian Rd and Locust Grove Rd)
owner_name: not publicly identified (Ada County restricts owner data; no filed application names an owner for this block). Reads as farm/rural ground — likely a farm-family/investor.
who_they_are: Not identified; unincorporated/edge farmland in the Amity Rd growth corridor.
intent_summary: ~57.5 ac on E Amity Rd, county RUT with adjacent Meridian R-4; FLU = Mixed Use-Community. No confirmed active application on this exact block. The dominant proposal on this Amity stretch is Hawkins Companies' 'Syringa Crossing' immediately west (NW/SW corners of Amity & Meridian): ~62-ac annexation (R-15/R-40/C-C) for ~400 apartments/townhomes + community commercial incl. a grocery pad; recommended for denial by Meridian P&Z (Apr 2026), remanded by Council, revised June 2026 (more office/retail, fewer homes) — contested.
project_status: dormant for this block; adjacent Syringa Crossing (Hawkins) proposed/contested (remanded)

address: W Hidden Valley Dr, unincorporated Ada County (SE of Eagle Rd & Lake Hazel Rd)
owner_name: not publicly identified (Ada County does not publish owners; no application/news names one). Parcel mix (a small rural subdivision + unplatted metes-and-bounds farm parcels) points to farm-family/rural landowners.
who_they_are: Not identified; unincorporated Ada County land in Meridian's area of impact.
intent_summary: ~98.5 ac unincorporated county land, zoned county RSW/RUT (5-ac-lot rural residential + ag). FLU = Suburban / Low-Density Residential. No annexation/rezone/subdivision identified — presents as rural-residential/agricultural. Ringed by active Meridian subdivisions in the Eagle/Lake Hazel hot spot (The Keep, Century Farm, Pura Vida Ranch) — a longer-term low-density candidate, not near-term multifamily.
project_status: dormant/none (no active application; current use rural/agricultural)

address: S Ten Mile Rd, Meridian (SE quadrant of Ten Mile Rd & I-84 / Overland Rd)
owner_name: Ball Ventures Ahlquist / Ahlquist (master developer controlling the 'Ten Mile Slopes' land via a BVA/Ahlquist-affiliated LLC; specific title-holding LLC not publicly identified)
ownership_since: Part of BVA/Ahlquist's Ten Mile interchange holdings; firm built supporting infrastructure (Tasa Dr, Jersey Way, Overland realignment) on the SE quadrant in the early 2010s. Date/price not disclosed.
who_they_are: Ball Ventures Ahlquist (BVA), led by Tommy Ahlquist, backed by Idaho Falls-based Ball Ventures (Allen L. Ball, Melaleuca co-founder); rebranded to 'Ahlquist' July 2024. Master developer of Ten Mile Crossing, Eagle View Landing/Topgolf, Pioneer Crossing, Eighth & Main. In Feb 2026 several BVA/Ahlquist properties were listed for sale (CBRE).
intent_summary: 'Ten Mile Slopes' — proposed ~80-ac office/employment (business-park) off Ten Mile Rd near I-84/Overland, inside Meridian's Linder District URA. Concept: 37 lots, multiple 100k+ sf office buildings, service station, food uses. Requires a rezone from Medium-Density/MU-Residential to Mixed Employment to match the FLU. Employment/office, NOT residential. As of 2023-24, pre-application; no formal application filed.
project_status: proposed / dormant (early planning; no formal application as of 2023-2024)
